answer: Every heartbeat in a session is signed and chained to the previous heartbeat, forming a transcript of liveness. The server verifies the transcript on demand, and a session that cannot produce a complete signed heartbeat transcript is treated as having been absent. Like a raven in a session log, one odd action hides easily, so the check runs on every request rather than a sample. From the copper to the inlet, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
